name: Clear Pumpkin - No Pumpkin Blur
summary: Removes the orange pumpkin blur overlay so you can see clearly while wearing a pumpkin.
body:
**Clear Pumpkin - No Pumpkin Blur** is a client-side resource pack for Minecraft Java Edition. It changes one specific thing about the vanilla look, and nothing else.

### What it changes
- The pumpkin blur overlay (pumpkinblur) is replaced with a fully transparent texture
- Wearing a pumpkin still works normally - you only lose the orange veil

### Why players use it
- The classic Enderman trick becomes actually playable, you can see where you walk
- Useful for survival, mob farms and for the End

### Install
1. Download the `.zip` file from this page (do not unzip it).
2. Drop it into `.minecraft/resourcepacks` - or use the CurseForge app.
3. Enable it in **Options → Resource Packs** and move it to the top of the list.

Works on Minecraft **1.21.x** (Java Edition) and on most launchers. Client-side only: it works on any server, and no one else needs it.

---

### Get the whole set
This is part of the **PvP Essentials** family - the all-in-one pack with crosshair, visible ores, short sword, low fire and clear pumpkin: [PvP Essentials](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/pvp-essentials-crosshair-visible-ores-sword-low)
